problem.title: Next Greater Element I
problem.problemStatement: You are given two arrays nums1 and nums2 where all elements are unique and nums1 is a subset of nums2. For each element in nums1, find the first greater element to its right in nums2. If no such element exists, return -1 for that element.
problem.input: Integer n Array nums1 Integer m Array nums2
problem.output: An array containing the next greater element for every element in nums1.
problem.constraints: 1 <= n <= m <= 1000 All elements are unique.
